name: Psoriatic Arthritis
definition: Immune-mediated inflammatory arthritis associated with psoriasis, with peripheral arthritis, enthesitis, dactylitis, axial disease and nail involvement.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical supported by labs and imaging.
investigations.MRI: MRI/ultrasound can demonstrate synovitis/enthesitis or axial inflammation.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs show structural change in established disease.

amber: DMARD, biologic and targeted therapy require specialist monitoring.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Ekakushtha/Psoriasis-related inflammatory joint phenotype may be documented; no single Ayurvedic label should replace PsA classification.

patientEducation.summary: Immune-mediated inflammatory arthritis associated with psoriasis, with peripheral arthritis, enthesitis, dactylitis, axial disease and nail involvement.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
